channel.title: Harvest Family Radio Guam - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Harvest Family Radio Guam (khmg.org)

item.title: Guest Host Jared Ball Returns with Friends | Harvest Family Radio
item.description: This week Jared Ball was our guest host again, and he was joined by Seth, Marty, and Caeley to play a new game in the second hour called “Hot and Cold.”

item.title: Tim Bennett | Harvest Family Radio
item.description: Pastor Jake Schnoor is our guest host this week. He spoke with Tim Bennett about growing up, coming to know Christ, joining the Navy, and coming to Guam.

item.title: Be Witnesses | Harvest Family Radio
item.description: After His resurrection and before Jesus returned to be with His Father, He made a prediction. His disciples would “tell what they know” all over the world.

item.title: Give it a Google: Fun Facts and Stories Backed by Research | Harvest Family Radio
item.description: This week Hope Holloway, our guest host, had a fun segment called “Fact or Fiction” where the guests tried to guess if the crazy laws were fact or fiction.

item.title: Tasi Castro | Harvest Family Radio
item.description: Guest host Pastor Ken Keith spoke with Tasi Castro this week about growing up at Harvest, her family, coming to know Christ, and having adopted siblings.

item.title: Food and Fun with Jared Ball | Harvest Family Radio
item.description: This week Jared Ball was once again our guest host, and he aired a new segment called “Culinary Curiosity” to close out the first hour with Seth and Nate.

item.title: Salomon and Davelyn David | Harvest Family Radio
item.description: Guests from Pohnpei Salomon and Davelyn David spoke with Pastor Walton about growing up, coming to Christ, and joining the ministry at Good News Baptist Church.

item.title: Talking with T’Nel Mori, head of Harvest Security | Harvest Family Radio
item.description: This week T’Nel Mori joined us to talk about his role at Harvest, pastoring a Chuukese church, how he got connected to Harvest, his family, and prayer requests.

item.title: Mike and Sophia Abbe | Harvest Family Radio
item.description: Mike and Sophia Abbe spoke to Pastor Walton this week about coming to know Christ, growing in their faith, and continuing in local church ministry on Chuuk.

item.title: Dr. Chopo Mwanza | Harvest Family Radio
item.description: Dr. Chopo Mwanza is the pastor at Faith Baptist Church Riverside in Kitwe, Zambia. He was recently our keynote speaker at the Harvest missions conference.
